description: LangChain ChatOpenAI with one bound tool: a tool call, the tool run, then the answer, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch. Only LangchainInstrumentor is enabled. ChatOpenAI is pointed at the mock. The capture is three root spans: ChatOpenAI.chat, execute_tool get_weather, and ChatOpenAI.chat again. Token counts are copied from LangChain usage_metadata: input 82 then 131, output 17 then 12, cache_read 0 then 64. The total is the sum of those input and output counts. Finish reasons are mapped from tool_calls to tool_call, then stop. The chat spans also carry empty traceloop.workflow.name and traceloop.entity.path, plus LangChain metadata under traceloop.association.properties. LangChain run ids are pinned to a counter.
